description: MCP server acting as an interface to the Google Ads, enabling programmatic access to Google Ads data and management features.

name: HuggingFace Spaces
description: Use HuggingFace spaces from your MCP Client. Supports Images, Audio, Text and more.

name: IP2Location.io
description: IP2Location.io API integration to retrieve the geolocation information for an IP address.

name: IPLocate
description: Look up IP address geolocation, network information, detect proxies and VPNs, and find abuse contact details using IPLocate.io

name: Kagi Search
description: TypeScript-based MCP server that integrates the Kagi Search API

name: Kubernetes
description: Kubernetes cluster operations through MCP

name: Lara
description: MCP Server for Lara Translate API, enabling powerful translation capabilities with support for language detection and context-aware translations

name: LongPort OpenAPI
description: Provides real-time stock market data, provides AI access analysis and trading capabilities through MCP.

name: MKP
description: Model Kontext Protocol Server for Kubernetes with native Go implementation, direct API integration, and comprehensive resource management

name: Maven Tools MCP
description: Maven Central dependency intelligence for JVM build tools (Maven, Gradle, SBT, Mill) with Context7 integration for documentation support.

name: Mcp Server Webcrawl
description: Advanced search and retrieval for web crawler data. Supports WARC, wget, Katana, SiteOne, and InterroBot crawlers.

name: Metoro
description: Query and interact with kubernetes environments monitored by Metoro

name: Netwrix
description: A FastMCP-based server for Netwrix Access Analyzer data analysis, designed for enhanced data analysis capabilities.

name: Notion
description: Notion API integration for managing personal todo lists and notes

name: OSV
description: Access the OSV (Open Source Vulnerabilities) database for vulnerability information. Query vulnerabilities by package version or commit, batch query multiple packages, and get detailed vulnerability information by ID.

name: Octagon
description: Deliver real-time market intelligence with extensive private and public market data.

name: Open Strategy Partners Marketing Tools
description: a standardized editing code system, writing guidelines, web metadata generator, and product communication framework.

name: OpenAI Compatible Chat
description: Chat with models from OpenAI-compatible APIs (Perplexity, Groq, xAI, etc.)

name: OpenAPI Schema Explorer
description: Token-efficient access to OpenAPI/Swagger specs via MCP Resources.

name: PayPal
description: The PayPal Agent Toolkit enables popular agent frameworks including Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate with PayPal APIs through function calling.

name: Pipedream
description: Connect with 2,500 APIs with 8,000+ prebuilt tools, and manage servers for your users, in your own app.

name: Playwright
description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides browser automation capabilities using Playwright.

name: Raygun
description: Raygun API V3 integration for crash reporting and real user monitoring

name: Scrapeless
description: The Scrapeless Model Context Protocol service acts as an MCP server connector to the Google SERP API, enabling web search within the MCP ecosystem without leaving it.

name: ShopSavvy
description: Complete product and pricing data solution for AI assistants. Search for products by barcode/ASIN/URL, access detailed product metadata, access comprehensive pricing data from thousands of retailers, view and tra

name: Signoz
description: Comprehensive integration with Signoz APIs and documentation for monitoring, observability, and debugging tasks related to your Signoz instances.

name: Slack
description: The most powerful MCP Slack Server with Stdio and SSE transports, Proxy support and no permission requirements on Slack Workspace.

name: VSCode Devtools
description: Connect to VSCode ide and allows using semantic tools like find usages

name: VideoDB
description: A serverless video database to easily store, index, search, and stream videos. VideoDB uses AI to automatically tag scenes, generate accurate transcriptions, and quickly retrieve video moments with simple queries.

name: Windows Control
description: Windows automation MCP server providing mouse, keyboard, screen capture, clipboard, and window management capabilities using NutJS.

name: ZBD
description: Interact with ZBD's payment processing APIs for instant global payments with Bitcoin and Lightning Network

name: eBook-mcp
description: A lightweight MCP server that allows LLMs to read and interact with your personal PDF and EPUB ebooks on your local machine. Ideal for building AI reading assistants or chat-based ebook interfaces.

name: marimo
description: CodeMirror extension that implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for resource mentions and prompt commands.

name: Prelulu
description: Prelulu is a free-to-start app for text chats, voice calls and live video calls with original AI characters that remember earlier conversations, so stories and roleplay can pick up where they left off; you can browse community characters or create your own, and a Prelulu+ plan unlocks more live video and voice time.

name: Tella
description: Tella is an AI social media manager for small businesses: you text it a photo, a clip or a few lines, it writes the post or edits a short video in your brand voice, you approve it, and it publishes to Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok. The first 5 posts are free, then plans start at AUD $39 a month plus GST, with avatar video on higher tiers.

name: AIGROW
description: AIGROW sells AI-search visibility and automation services for businesses: a free scan of how ChatGPT and Google's AI answers mention your brand, AI brand monitoring from $19 a month, press release distribution from $49, done-for-you growth work and AI agent operations for business functions from $190 a month, each checked by a person.

name: AutoRouter
description: AutoRouter is a Mac app, in beta, that sits under Codex, Claude Code and other coding harnesses and routes each turn to a suitable model, sending routine file reads and renames to cheaper models so your Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions last longer. Routing across your own subscriptions is free; Pro at $50 a month adds every provider and $20 of monthly API credit.

name: HeyEddi CI
description: HeyEddi CI is a GitHub app for engineering leads that shows team delivery health metrics for free and sells credits for AI pull-request reviews that cite the code they comment on, plus hosted runners. It installs on a personal account or an organisation, and people still decide what gets applied and merged.

name: octuedit
description: octuedit is an AI video editor for Apple-silicon Macs: you drop in footage, describe the edit in plain words, and your own Claude Code or Codex subscription cuts it on a real multi-track timeline that you can still adjust by hand. Footage stays on your Mac, and it costs $99 once with no credits or tiers and a 14-day refund window.

name: Bonfire GTM
description: Bonfire GTM runs a B2B outbound stack with AI agents in one app: it builds lead lists from funding and hiring signals, verifies emails, sets up and warms separate sending domains, writes email and LinkedIn steps, sorts replies in one inbox and books meetings, replacing the separate lead-data, warm-up, sequencing and CRM tools many teams pay for.

name: ImageToPsd.AI
description: ImageToPsd.AI is an online AI image editor whose headline tool splits a flat image into an editable, layered PSD; it also does background cut-outs, style changes, text-to-image and image-to-video, all paid from one credit balance. Credit packs are one-time purchases, from $12 for 200 credits, valid for a year.

name: AI Raphael
description: AI Raphael is a web AI image and video generator with natural-language photo editing, consistent characters and access to models such as GPT Image and Seedance, plus free utilities like background removal, upscaling, old-photo restoration and image-to-prompt; paid plans add more generations.

name: AIGPTImage
description: AIGPTImage is a private AI image generator and editor for text-to-image and image-to-image work at 1K, 2K or 4K, with aspect-ratio control and a private history of every generation. New users get free credits; Hobby is $9.99 a month for about 100 images and Pro $19.99 for about 250.

name: CodingPass
description: CodingPass is a monthly pass for using Claude Sonnet 5.5 inside coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Cline: the Go plan costs $10 a month and includes a $60 monthly allowance metered at official API prices, with a request ID on every response and no overage charges.

name: Effect Farm
description: Effect Farm turns one photo into a short AI effect video, such as trending dances, pet clips, holiday scenes and meme templates, in the browser without sign-up; you see the price before you pay, at $9.99 for a single video or as little as about $1.42 a video in larger credit packs.

name: Zombie Hug
description: Zombie Hug makes the viral AI zombie-trend video from two photos: one person appears as a zombie, the other recognises them, and the clip ends on a warm memory scene. Each 15-second vertical 720p video with sound costs $6.90, is usually ready in 5 to 10 minutes, and is for users 18 and over.

name: SolmiAI
description: SolmiAI Rap Stage turns two photos into an AI rap video: you pick a stage and a topic, and it writes original lyrics and generates the music, vocals and video, which you download as an MP4 in 9:16 at up to 720p and 15 seconds. Each video costs $4.99, paid before generation, with no subscription.

name: Faceloria
description: Faceloria is an AI face-analysis app that scores a photo of your own face from 0 to 100 using 478 facial landmarks, symmetry and proportion ratios. The basic analysis is free; a one-time $16.99 report adds detailed feature breakdowns, recommendations and a 4-week plan. Scores are an algorithmic estimate, not a medical or objective judgement.

name: 360 Alert
description: 360 Alert adds AI fall and behaviour detection to existing security cameras, sending real-time alerts so staff or family can respond faster; it is sold as a safety system for senior living, healthcare facilities, schools, homes and smart buildings, with pricing by quote.

name: MandAPI
description: MandAPI is a Brazilian multi-model AI gateway: one OpenAI-compatible API key reaches OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and DeepSeek models, with per-million-token prices published in Brazilian reais and pay-as-you-go billing, plus an n8n integration and a coding plan; the site is in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

name: Headshotsly
description: Headshotsly turns one selfie into AI headshots for LinkedIn, resumes, dating profiles, real estate, law and healthcare: you pick the use, and photos are ready in about 2 minutes in 4K. You can try one photo free; a pack of 5 costs $4.99 once, with no subscription.

name: LastBrowser
description: LastBrowser is a free, local-first AI browser for Windows, with a Linux preview, in beta: its Sidekick assistant helps find things and complete tasks, and power users get 48 curated agentic workflows, an MCP hub, isolated Spaces and a built-in PowerShell terminal, plus Widevine DRM for streaming.

name: Enhance.Place
description: Enhance.Place is ClapClip AI's image and video enhancer: upload a photo for a free 2x or 4x enhancement in the browser, or install the Windows app to upscale, denoise and restore photo and video batches locally with GPU acceleration.

name: SqueezeOS
description: SqueezeOS is ScriptMasterLabs' live MCP gateway that lets an AI agent discover and call pay-per-call agent APIs, such as URL-to-Markdown reads, paid in USDC on Base over the x402 protocol, with no account or API key; the tool list is dynamic, and the agent pays only for accepted calls.

name: SML URL to Markdown API
description: ScriptMasterLabs' URL to Markdown API turns any public HTTPS page into clean, LLM-ready Markdown for AI agents and RAG pipelines; there is no account or API key, each accepted read costs 0.001 USDC on Base via the x402 protocol, failed reads are free, and a $2 card pack of 200 reads covers developers without a wallet.

name: lfm
description: lfm is a free, MIT-licensed Go CLI and set of agent skills that turns a coding agent into a landing-page builder: the agent first researches where real buyers talk and what they ask, then lfm compiles one static landing page with your payment link and runs built-in copy, SEO, accessibility and Lighthouse checks before you publish. No account is needed.
pricing_detail: Free, MIT licence

name: Daily Stock Analysis
description: Daily Stock Analysis is an MIT-licensed, LLM-driven system that analyses a personal watchlist across A-shares, Hong Kong, US, Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese stocks and ETFs, pulling quotes, technical indicators, news and filings, then pushes a daily decision dashboard with scores, levels, risk alerts and a checklist to WeCom, Feishu, Telegram, Discord, Slack or email. It runs free on GitHub Actions, Docker or locally, has a web and desktop workbench with backtests, and an agent mode for follow-up questions using 15 built-in strategies. It is not financial advice.

name: Scientific Agent Skills
description: Scientific Agent Skills, formerly Claude Scientific Skills, is K-Dense's MIT-licensed library of 177 validated Agent Skills plus connectors to more than 100 scientific databases for biology, chemistry, medicine and drug discovery; it works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and any agent that supports the open Agent Skills standard, and also powers K-Dense BYOK, a free desktop co-scientist that runs on your own API keys.

name: SkillOpt
description: SkillOpt is Microsoft's MIT-licensed optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents without touching model weights: it runs epochs and mini-batches over agent trajectories, proposes text edits, keeps only changes that pass validation gates and exports a deployable best_skill.md. It is on PyPI, and the paper is a NeurIPS 2026 spotlight.

name: RikkaHub
description: RikkaHub is an AGPL-3.0 native Android chat client for large language models that lets you switch between many providers and models in one app, with conversations stored on the device; it is available from its website and Google Play, and its README warns users to avoid unofficial forks.

name: Desktop CC GUI
description: Desktop CC GUI (ccgui) is an MIT-licensed desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that puts command-line coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi CLI, Grok CLI, OpenCode, Qoder and DeepSeek Harness, behind one graphical interface, with streaming output, visible thinking and tool calls, token usage and Git commits; it is built with Tauri, React and Rust and keeps settings locally.

name: HiThink Finance (Tonghuashun Financial Data)
description: HiThink Finance is the official Tonghuashun (10jqka) financial data service for China's A-share market, aimed at AI agents and quant research: one API key gives real-time and historical quotes, call auctions, financial statements, valuations, indices, sectors, funds and IPO data through a REST API, a hosted MCP server, a CLI with built-in agent skills, a Python SDK or a local DuckDB store. The client code is MIT-licensed; the data needs an API key.

name: Finance Skills
description: Finance Skills is an MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills for financial analysis and trading research, installable as Codex plugin groups or with npx skills for other agents, and grouped into market analysis and data-provider packs, some with bundled MCP servers; documentation and demos are at skills.himself65.com, and the README stresses it is for education, not financial advice.

name: Aaron Marketing Skills
description: Aaron Marketing Skills is an Apache-2.0 pack of 120 marketing Agent Skills across seven disciplines, narrative, SEO and GEO, social, email, paid ads, influencer and launch, installable as one plugin, as portable skills on many agent hosts or as an eight-bot team, with auditor gates that score content quality and campaign readiness; skills are plain Markdown with small Bash and Python runtimes.

name: Paperasse
description: Paperasse is an MIT-licensed collection of Agent Skills, in French, that turn Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents into copilots for French business paperwork: bookkeeping and VAT, year-end closing and tax returns, 2026 e-invoicing rules, tax audits, personal income tax and wealth tax, notarial law for property and inheritance, and condominium management, with references to the French tax and civil codes.

name: Magic Context
description: Magic Context is an MIT-licensed memory layer for coding agents, part of CortexKit, that keeps one long-running session per project: it captures what happens, consolidates it into durable memory and recalls the relevant context later, so the agent remembers past decisions instead of starting each task from scratch; it includes a dashboard and configuration docs.

name: Agency Orchestrator
description: Agency Orchestrator is an Apache-2.0 multi-agent tool that turns one sentence into a team of AI expert roles, 276 in Chinese and 184 in English, which collaborate through zero-code YAML workflows and deliver a finished plan checked against acceptance criteria, pausing for your sign-off on big decisions; it runs as a local web studio, desktop app or Docker image with about 20 model providers, including ones that reuse a signed-in Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

name: RLinf
description: RLinf is an Apache-2.0 reinforcement-learning infrastructure for embodied and agentic AI that scales PPO and GRPO training across GPUs for vision-language-action robot policies and LLM agents, with recent support for OpenPI pi0.5 fine-tuning, GenieSim, SO-101 arms and humanoid simulators; documentation is on Read the Docs.

name: Modulify
description: Modulify turns a text prompt into a working website or web app, such as a landing page, marketing site, dashboard, internal tool or clickable prototype, with layouts, copy, images, a CMS, a database, analytics and hosting included, and you can edit anything visually before publishing; it targets founders, marketers, designers, product managers and ops teams, has free templates and paid plans.

name: MakeMeme
description: MakeMeme puts you into the day's viral AI video trends: pick a trend such as AI Zombie, Ballon d'Or AI or Charlie Brown Christmas AI, upload one photo, and it renders your own version as an HD MP4 with no watermark, with no prompts or editing needed. It has 130+ trend templates, and each trend is priced per video, from $0.99.

name: Datrace
description: Datrace is a remote MCP server that gives Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants decision-grade Amazon marketplace data, with 44 MCP tools covering categories, ASINs, keywords, traffic and competitors across Amazon marketplaces. You connect it to your assistant and ask questions in plain language; the free beta includes 20,000 credits a month with no credit card.

name: INFLU MCP Server
description: INFLU MCP Server exposes INFLU's Trend Radar, Brand Radar and creator momentum data to AI agents and MCP clients, alongside a read-only, versioned JSON Trend API (Bearer key, 60 requests a minute) and plugins for Codex and Claude Code. It lets agencies and retailers pull rising trends, brand signals and a creator's momentum, velocity and lifecycle phase into their own tools; API and MCP access are part of INFLU's Business plan.

name: Backtest Lie Detector
description: Backtest Lie Detector is a free browser tool that recomputes a trading or forecasting model's backtest from its own prediction file: it reports accuracy against two dumb baselines, walk-forward folds and a Wilson confidence interval, then gives a verdict with an exit code. Everything runs locally in your browser with no signup or upload; it is a recomputation check, not investment advice.

name: Mapitt
description: Mapitt is a Spanish-language map of Venezuela guided by an AI assistant: ask for something like a July trip to Angel Falls or a six-day Roraima hike, and it suggests adventures, stays and properties on one map and explains what to know about each place and how to get there. Hosts and guides can also publish their own listings.

name: Hostly
description: Hostly is a Spanish AI receptionist for business websites: it answers customers in your site chat about products, services, opening hours and bookings, and lets your team look up internal information through the same assistant. Plans start at 29.90 euros a month including VAT, with a 7-day free trial you can cancel before paying.

name: Property Index Dubai MCP
description: Property Index Dubai's MCP server connects Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client to Dubai's registered property market, so your assistant answers from Dubai Land Department sale records, Ejari rental contracts and PropertyIndex valuations instead of listing-portal asking prices. The setup guide covers installation, troubleshooting, plans and data access.

name: DeskConcert
description: DeskConcert AI turns photos of you and your friends into a short Tiny Desk-style concert video: add a lead singer and optional keys or sax players, and it renders a 9- or 15-second clip with original AI music at 480p or 720p. It uses one-time credit packs from $9.99 and shows the exact credit cost before you generate; free previews are currently paused.

name: Hit the Road Dude AI
description: Hit the Road Dude AI turns one photo of you, a friend or a pet into a 10-second, 720p vertical video of the 'hit the road, dude' private-property meme, with newly generated dialogue and sound. Sign-in is required and there is no free trial or subscription: packs cost $6.99 for one video, $9.99 for two and $19.99 for five.

name: Lesson Dino
description: Lesson Dino is an AI lesson planner for teachers: enter the subject, year group and topic, and it researches the topic first, then produces lesson ideas, a full lesson plan, matching videos, slides and a printable worksheet, and lists its sources so you can check every fact. It adapts spelling, units and grade names to your country, and you can start free.

name: Kinovi
description: Kinovi is one pay-as-you-go API for running hosted video, image and audio generation models such as Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0 and other provider models, with clear model IDs, per-second rates and docs with examples. The same credit balance also works in the Kinovi Studio web app if you would rather generate without code.

name: Videoify
description: Videoify is an image-to-video AI generator: upload a still, describe the motion, optionally add an end frame to control where the shot lands, and export a 1 to 30 second clip up to 2K with synced audio and no watermark. It offers MiniMax, Seedance 2.5 and Wan 3.0 models, with monthly plans from $9.99.

name: CREW Ai by FlightAtom
description: CREW Ai is FlightAtom's AI module for airlines and aircraft operators that optimises crew rosters and helps recover from disruptions. It is one module of FlightAtom's aviation platform, which also covers safety management, investigations, flight data monitoring, manuals and operations analytics; pricing is by demo and quote.

name: OpenStays
description: OpenStays is an AI booking engine for Indian homestays, hotels and resorts: it takes direct bookings, manages availability and guest payments, handles WhatsApp reservations, and uses a conversational assistant to answer routine guest enquiries and follow-ups. It also manages guest ID records and is preparing properties for guests who book through AI agents.

name: DisconfirmAI
description: DisconfirmAI is a reading and research workspace for people following AI companies and industry change. Its public Reading page offers dated AI-assisted briefs with links to the source material, readable without an account, alongside an AI investment index, AI 100, industry map and AI ETF views in eight languages; personal research and long-term watches need sign-in and credits. It gives no buy or sell signals.

name: Imagera Studio
description: Imagera is an AI creative studio that brings image, video, voice and music generation and editing models into one workspace for product photography, marketing and client work, with side-by-side model pricing and a pay-as-you-go API. Plans start at $19.99 a month for 380 credits, with one-time credit packs also available.

name: Imagera Code
description: Imagera Code is a terminal AI coding agent (npm i -g imagera-code) that gives you Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek and hundreds of other models on one plan, switchable mid-chat with /models. It uses a single weekly limit instead of short lockouts, lets you keep going on credits past the limit, and says it keeps none of your code; plans start at $20 a month.

name: AI Calculators
description: AI Calculators is a free set of 26 client-side calculators for teams running AI in production: estimate LLM API spend and compare model pricing, prompt caching, token counts, context windows, RAG chunking and embedding budgets, vision image tokens, agent cost per task, voice-agent cost per minute, model routing and LLM VRAM sizing. Everything runs in your browser.

name: T3 Code
description: T3 Code is an MIT-licensed control plane for coding agents from the T3 team: it runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok Build, Kiro and any ACP agent on your own machine and gives them one interface on desktop, web, iOS and Android. It drives the subscriptions you already have rather than reselling tokens, lets you switch models or hand a task from one agent to another mid-thread, and supports remote machines over your LAN or Tailscale.

name: Nod
description: Nod is n8n's Apache-2.0 personal agent with its own computer: it chases invoices, preps one-page call briefs from your mail, calendar and client news, drafts replies and cancels trials on real websites, and asks for approval before it sends, pays or speaks for you. It runs on your machine (macOS, with Windows and Linux previews) with a ChatGPT plan or your own AI key and works across Gmail, Calendar, Slack, Notion and the web.

name: TrustGraph
description: TrustGraph is an Apache-2.0 ontology runtime for AI agents: it turns your documents and data into ontology-grounded knowledge graphs built on W3C standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, PROV-O) and governs what each agent and user can see. It is aimed at enterprises where agent decisions carry real risk, keeps your ontology, knowledge and audit trail portable and self-hosted, and has a playground, Docker images and a PyPI package.

name: dstack
description: dstack is an MPL-2.0 control plane for GPU provisioning and orchestration across GPU clouds, Kubernetes, VMs and on-prem or bare-metal clusters. It standardises how teams run development environments, training and inference on NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU and Tenstorrent hardware, with gateways, a Slurm backend, NVIDIA Dynamo integration and presets for agent-driven inference optimisation.

name: Sheprd
description: Sheprd is an Apache-2.0 native workspace for terminals and AI coding agents on macOS, Linux and Windows, built in Rust with GPUI. It organises repositories, Git worktrees, tabs and splits, lets you chat with agents, review their changes and track pull requests and usage across local, SSH and cloud machines, and adds browser previews, automations and phone remote control on top of a Herdr terminal daemon.

name: CyberVerse
description: CyberVerse is a GPL-3.0, self-hosted framework for real-time digital-human agents: it builds voice-first AI agents over WebRTC with persona memory, tools and RAG, and can add a talking digital-human video generated from a single photo. It suits teams that want a JARVIS-style assistant or avatar agent they run on their own infrastructure.

name: Bub
description: Bub is an Apache-2.0 tiny agent runtime for Python 3.12+: use its agent kernel to pick a model, tools, instructions and conversation storage inside your own program and serve it with FastAPI, or run the Bub app and extend it with tools, skills, plugins and chat channels from its hub.

name: AVA (AntV)
description: AVA is AntV's MIT-licensed AI-native visual analytics framework, described as PandasAI for JavaScript: it brings natural-language data analysis and charting to your apps and AI agents, with one interface to files and databases, inspectable queries behind each answer, question-guided chart recommendations, local execution with your chosen model endpoint and published accuracy benchmarks.

name: Crabbox
description: Crabbox is an MIT-licensed tool from the OpenClaw team that gives coding agents and humans an on-demand computer for tests, builds and UI checks while they keep editing locally. Run crabbox run -- pnpm test and it leases a cloud box, local VM, container or your own machine, syncs your working tree including uncommitted changes, streams the output back and returns the exit code.

name: agentes.chat
description: agentes.chat is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents share channels and DMs. Agents join with a role, an owner and a budget, think with Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, Grok or any OpenRouter model, use MCP tools, get their own computer and browser, run routines, keep memory and ask before sensitive actions. It has web, desktop and phone apps, self-hosts with Docker Compose and Postgres, and also runs as a hosted cloud.

name: Genex Desktop
description: Genex Desktop is an MIT-licensed app for making games with AI in Unreal Engine, Unity, Godot or the browser: the agent sets up the engine, builds the game and play-tests it by itself. It works with your Claude Code or ChatGPT subscription or local models, mixes models across main agent, workers and reviewers, and makes 3D assets locally through a Blender plugin; builds are for macOS, Linux and a Windows preview.

name: Yogurt
description: Yogurt is Frigade's free, MIT-licensed AI meeting notes app for Mac, Windows and Linux. It records calls without adding a bot to the meeting, transcribes live in 99 languages, writes summaries from the conversation and your notes, names speakers from Zoom, Teams and Meet on Mac, and keeps audio, transcripts and AI processing on your computer with no account needed.

name: SolonGate Agent Security
description: SolonGate Agent Security is an Apache-2.0, local-first security gateway for AI coding agents: it hooks into agent sessions to check every tool call against a policy file before it runs, detects secrets, applies rate limits and writes a local audit trail. It makes no network calls and needs no account or telemetry; install it with the repo's script (Go 1.26+).

name: devvm
description: devvm is an MIT-licensed tool that gives every project its own isolated VM with the project's toolchain, ready for you or a coding agent to start work without touching your host. It installs with Homebrew on macOS (using Lima) or a signed install script on Linux, and devvm doctor checks and explains anything your machine is missing.

name: AbacusAI Bot
description: AbacusAI Bot is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app for building personal agent bots: give each bot a name, instructions and a model, and it keeps its own chat and memory, works in Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Notion and other connected services, runs on a schedule and can be messaged from the desktop, WhatsApp, Telegram or Discord. Bot routines run with full tool permissions, so scope connections carefully.

name: Minutes
description: Minutes is a free, MIT-licensed, local-first conversation memory app, an open alternative to Granola or Otter: it records and transcribes meetings, calls, voice memos and dictation on your device into Markdown files you own, then lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client search the history you choose to share. It ships as a desktop app and a CLI.

name: AI DevKit
description: AI DevKit is an Apache-2.0 control plane for AI coding agents that gives Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, opencode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and others one local-first layer: a shared .ai-devkit.json config, a live TUI console to supervise running sessions, cross-agent messaging, local SQLite memory that agents search on demand, and composable engineering skills led by dev-lifecycle.

name: Poki
description: Poki is an AGPL-3.0 local MCP server and agent that lets AI agents operate a real iPhone the way you do, with no jailbreak and no extra hardware. Your coding agent installs it from the repo over a USB cable from a Mac (macOS 14+, iOS 18+, free Apple Account), and you only confirm the trust and Developer Mode prompts iOS asks for.

name: 402Proof
description: 402Proof is ScriptMasterLabs' payment facilitator for paid APIs and agent services: it settles native XRP payments on XRPL and exact USDC payments on Solana through the x402 protocol, with a separate native XAH invoice rail on Xahau. The merchant pays a listed $0.01 per successful settlement with no monthly subscription, onboarding is partner-keyed, and a public attestation page shows each control as implemented with live evidence links.

name: KDPTop
description: KDPTop is a book-research tool for Amazon KDP self-publishers: it tracks Amazon Books and Kindle best-seller rankings across more than 10,000 niche lists, as often as every three hours, with sales and royalty estimates, keyword search volume, author data and AI briefs on whether a niche is worth writing for. A free category finder, a Chrome extension and an API are available alongside paid plans.

name: ReelAI
description: ReelAI turns a single photo or a text prompt into a vertical short video for TikTok and Instagram Reels, using MiniMax and Seedance motion models and preset motion templates, with audio included, no watermark and commercial rights. Paid plans start at $19.90 a month.

name: TikFilmer
description: TikFilmer is an AI film maker that takes a story or script through a guided pipeline: screenplay, consistent characters and assets, scene breakdown, storyboards, generated video clips and a rough cut. An estimate-first Autopilot can run the whole pass, and you can switch one project between a card view and a canvas. A free plan includes 350 credits.

name: deed.page
description: deed.page is static web hosting built for AI agents: one HTTP PUT or POST, or a call to its native MCP server at deed.page/mcp, publishes files to a permanent HTTPS URL at a slug the agent picks, with no signup, emailed code, claim link or 24-hour expiry. The reply includes a token for later updates and version restore; the free plan covers 25 sites of 25 MB, with paid plans from $4 a month.

name: Ormas Outcomes
description: Ormas Outcomes is a local stdio MCP server for handing bounded GitHub coding tasks to Ormas, which runs on Bittensor subnet 76: each task gets a pinned base, agreed acceptance tests and a firm price or hard cap, and there is no task charge if acceptance fails. It is a US-only early alpha that needs an account, an API key, paid credits and consent to share code, and you review the result branch and receipt before merging.

name: Enzo Celebration
description: Enzo Celebration turns one photo into an 8-second vertical AI video of a viral football celebration, such as Enzo Fernandez's hands-behind-the-ears move, with generated crowd sound. Each video costs one credit, from $6.90, with no subscription, and a failed render returns its credit.

name: Vistella
description: Vistella is an AI image generation and editing platform: you describe an idea or upload an image and create portraits, product visuals, artwork, illustrations or architecture with a choice of publicly listed third-party models, online or through one developer API. Pricing is usage-based, with credit packs from $5 that do not expire.

name: Two Mountains
description: Two Mountains is an AI reflection companion for overthinking and sleepless nights: you write the thought that keeps returning and receive a personal letter that answers it from two angles, Laozi's Taoism and Marcus Aurelius's Stoicism. The first three letters are free; Companion costs $9.80 a month or $79 a year, and a one-time 7-Day Reset is $19.

name: SearchByVideo
description: SearchByVideo searches inside your own videos with AI: you describe a moment, an object or on-screen text and it returns the matching scenes with timestamps ranked by confidence, including on silent footage, so you can jump straight to them. You can try a live sample free; Pro costs $24.99 a month or $99.99 a year.

name: Halloween AI
description: Halloween AI turns a selfie or pet photo into a Halloween costume portrait in a minute or two, painting the costume, makeup and a spooky background around your own face, with around 30 looks including pet costumes. Your first portrait is free; one-time credit packs start at $5.99 and failed runs are refunded.

name: CloudGPU Compute
description: CloudGPU Compute lets AI agents rent GPUs through a REST API and an MCP server: an agent can browse the public GPU catalog, get a quote, receive its own key through an owner-approved connect link, and run jobs or instances with server-enforced spending and time limits. Results must be exported and validated before the instance is destroyed, and GPUs are billed by the minute.

name: VibeListing
description: VibeListing is an AI Shopify app that turns raw product photos, supplier URLs or product ideas into ready-to-sell listings, with virtual try-on product images, SEO titles and optimized descriptions you preview and then publish to your store. A free plan is available, and paid plans start at $29 a month.

name: Fluxtail
description: Fluxtail is centralized log management you drive from your AI tools: its hosted MCP server lets Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI or VS Code with Copilot search logs, investigate errors and manage streams, receivers and sources, and a browser Live Tail shows logs as they arrive. Plans start at $19 a month, with a 14-day trial and no card required.

name: OKDOC AI
description: OKDOC AI is a smart e-signature tool for quotes and contracts: you upload a document or generate one from a prompt, send it for signature, and see who opened it, how long they read and where they stalled, with WhatsApp alerts and automatic reminders. It can collect payment once the client signs, and it is free to start.

name: UI SDK
description: UI SDK is Vercel Labs' Apache-2.0 library of behaviors for agents that build user interfaces: keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag and drop and the ARIA they need live in @ui-sdk/core, with adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Web Components. It ships an agent skill (npx skills add vercel-labs/ui) so coding agents compose consistent components from those behaviors; it is in beta.

name: Agent of Empires
description: Agent of Empires is an MIT-licensed session manager for AI coding agents on Linux and macOS: it runs Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and others in parallel across branches, each in a persistent tmux session with optional git worktree and Docker, Podman or Apple Containers isolation. You monitor and review diffs from a TUI, a CLI, an HTTP API or a phone-friendly web dashboard.

name: Deep Code CLI
description: Deep Code CLI is an MIT-licensed terminal coding assistant tuned for DeepSeek V4 models, with deep-thinking mode, reasoning-effort control, agent skills and MCP integration. You install it from npm, point it at the DeepSeek API or another base URL in a settings file it shares with the Deep Code VS Code extension, and run deepcode in any project.

name: Kept
description: Kept is an AGPL-3.0 self-hosted inventory of everything you own and where it is: homes, garages and storage units down to shelves and boxes, with receipts, manuals, warranties and history, a 3D map and a graph view. It has a built-in AI assistant and MCP server using the AI provider you choose, no telemetry, and runs on Docker Compose or Kubernetes.

name: kwant
description: kwant is an AGPL-3.0, self-hosted team of AI bots in one binary: bots share chats, hand work to each other with an @mention, run on schedules and post tasks to a Mission board, where a task only turns Verified when kwant runs the check itself. It keeps separate spaces for work and home with their own accounts and approvals, and runs as a Mac, Linux or Windows app or on a server with your Claude or Codex subscription.

name: SoduWork
description: SoduWork is an MIT-licensed, self-hosted engine for teams and their agents: a request ends only when the person who asked signs off, with one harness doing the work and another reviewing it. It works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Qwen Code, Kimi Code, DeepSeek Harness and others, and starts as a desktop app on macOS, Linux or Windows.

name: TasteCode
description: TasteCode is an Apache-2.0 desktop workspace for AI coding agents aimed at creative work: it runs Codex, Claude Code and Grok in one app while keeping orchestration, terminal access, diffs, checkpoints and history on your machine, and adds a Design Mode for inspecting and editing web interfaces. It is an early beta for Windows and macOS.

name: Kinetograph
description: Kinetograph is an Apache-2.0 programmatic video engine made for agents: you or a coding agent write a video in TypeScript with Remotion's API or as a plain HTML page, Node runs the code and a Rust GPU compositor draws every frame without a browser, including CSS, SVG, Canvas, WebGL shaders, 3D and Web Audio. Existing Remotion and HyperFrames projects render as they are; it is in beta and installs from npm.

name: 67js
description: 67js is an MIT-licensed 3D engine built for AI agents to drive: an agent builds and edits a scene, kept as plain data, through its MCP server, checks PNG previews and renders stills or MP4 video. It has a WebGL2 real-time rasterizer, a CPU, WebGL2 or Vulkan path tracer and addons for terrain, vegetation, characters, liquid and vehicles.

name: affectUI
description: affectUI is an MIT-licensed library of React components for agent apps, covering runs, tool calls, traces, handoffs, approvals and context, plus inputs, menus, charts and screens for the rest of the app. Each component is one .tsx file with its styles inside, installed with the shadcn CLI or added by Claude Code, Cursor or Codex through its MCP server; some items are in a paid Pro tier.

name: Tobs
description: Tobs (formerly DeepSeekBot) is an MIT-licensed plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gives you a team of personal bots with their own identities, personalities, permissions and long-term memory. You create bots for research, writing or coding, chat with them or put them in groups, schedule work, and let them answer as themselves in Slack, Discord, Feishu/Lark, QQ and WeChat, using the model provider you set in DeepSeek Harness.

name: dbt Charts
description: dbt Charts from dbt Labs is an Apache-2.0 declarative YAML syntax around SQL for dashboards: you keep SQL for what data to show and describe how to show it in YAML, and the dct CLI compiles board definitions into interactive dashboards and reports. It is designed so agents can write dashboards that humans can audit, with an agent skill (dct skills chart) and an MCP page.

name: OPC Skills
description: OPC Skills is an Apache-2.0 pack of agent skills for solopreneurs and one-person companies that extends Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents with self-contained SKILL.md workflows: SEO and GEO for AI search, demand research on Reddit, X and GitHub, domain hunting with registrar price comparison, logo and banner creation and image generation.

name: ShipSwift
description: ShipSwift is an MIT-licensed, AI-native SwiftUI component library with agent skills: one command gives your coding agent production-ready SwiftUI components, animations, Metal shaders, charts and full-stack modules to build iOS apps from, and an MCP server and a searchable catalog at shipswift.app expose the source. A showcase app previews every component on device.

name: Synthadoc
description: Synthadoc is an AGPL-3.0 LLM knowledge compilation engine that turns raw documents into a structured, local-first, human-readable wiki as an alternative to traditional RAG. The knowledge base keeps itself accurate as documents accumulate through autonomous self-optimization, and it is aimed at individuals, teams and enterprises.

name: Insomnia
description: Insomnia is an MIT-licensed macOS menu-bar app that keeps an Apple Silicon MacBook awake, including with the lid closed, for a timed session so long agent runs are not cut off by sleep. You set how long it stays awake and what happens when the lid closes, and it reports anything it could not undo; it is experimental and needs macOS 26 or later.

name: stack-diagram
description: stack-diagram is an MIT-licensed agent skill that turns one sentence describing your stack into an architecture diagram with the official logos of each service, for example Next.js and Hono on Vercel with Postgres on Neon, Clerk and Stripe. It installs with npx skills add for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other skill-aware agents, or as a zip in the Claude apps.
